directionChange.title: Current direction: toy raft + giant funny hand fans
directionChange.summary: R1 is locally playable: round toy raft, giant hand fans, small A/D player slide, Space fan strokes, four-ready crew and a 156 m obstacle course. P1 delivers a richer harbour landing with protected menu text, expressive toy crew, quieter water/wakes, owned fan feedback and a hands-on solo lesson. The menu is checked across 10 layouts. Four dividers keep player corridors clear. Physics0.2 removes passive current and gives measured coast-to-rest after release; four-client and camera checks pass. R1 human/art/timing gates and the complete 4–4.5 minute R2 course remain open. The ledger and M1–M5 checks below are historical paddle-prototype evidence; their PASS counts do not transfer to the fan game.

items.designCard: Composition: Warm cedar-lined small river, distant mill, gentle current. Skill focus: Catch/release; coordinated straight line and first counter-strokes. Hero moment: Split cedar posts and natural S-bend. Fail-forward route: No fatal falls; sandy recovery banks; launch dock. Audiovisual signature: Birds, small water wash, oar close-ups. First-time design objective: First clean stroke, two-player side yaw and group cadence. Mastered-time proposal: 12–18 minutes, to be re-estimated after player data.
